decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, BM 28342-A-SK-100 Rev. G Received: 31 March 2016 Heritage Statement Received: 18 May 2016 Lamp post specifications received: 23 May 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 5 - The anti-slip strips hereby approved, shall be coloured and yellow and shall be permenantly mainted thereafter with yellow anti-slip strips.
description: Alterations to the walkway under Kew Bridge including floor mounted railings, anti-slip strips on the existing steps and a new lamp post on the eastern side of the walkway.
